What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones

 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We br... 1 Software Engineer - Engine Integration (m/f/d) Job description
Our Product Engineers are domain experts first, developers second. They build Engines - the simulations and models that capture how buildings actually behave - fast, and increasingly with AI. But these prototypes live on GitHub and only run on laptops: untested against the platform, unavailable to customers.

That's the gap you close. You're the key counterpart to our Product Engineers: you understand what an Engine computes, how, and why - well enough to decide where each piece belongs, hand off what belongs to other teams, and build the rest yourself. No finished spec lands in your inbox. You read other people's code, ask the right questions, and turn a working prototype into a service we can run and trust. We work in a strongly agentic way - so will you.

Your mission
 * Run our Engines and make them better - correct, fast, observable. When results look wrong, you can tell whether it's the data, the integration, or the physics.

 * Onboard new prototypes - understand the method and edge cases; judge what's production-ready and what needs a rewrite.

 * Find the right home for each function - decompose monoliths and define the interfaces and data contracts that make those boundaries real.

 * Integrate - with Planning and our Systems Architects, translating between domain and platform language, then build what remains yourself.

 * Make the next Engine easier than the last - shape the conventions that let prototypes arrive closer to integration-ready.

You won't do this alone: DevOps, App/Experience, AI, and Data & Flows already own their domains.

Your profile
 * Several years of professional software engineering across the stack, centre of gravity in the backend.

 * Python and TypeScript - strong in one, comfortable in the other, attached to neither.

 * The ability to read and judge code you didn't write, including scientific and numerical code.

 * A low-ego, collaborative style with domain experts, and the skill to explain trade-offs to people who think in physics, not architecture.

 * Professional English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice-to-have

 * Geometry in code (computational geometry, meshes, CAD or BIM/IFC).

 * Simulation and numerical methods (thermal/energy simulation, FEM/CFD, solvers).

 * Real experience with AI and agentic workflows.

 * Productionizing research or prototype code (ML pipelines, scientific computing, quant models).

 * Building-industry or energy-domain exposure.

Why us?
 * Real impact. The Engines you integrate don't sit in a demo - they feed real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - you work across a complete product portfolio, not isolated one-off projects. Every Engine you bring in has a real place in the whole.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option and a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000 - €75,000 gross/year, depending on your experience.

About us
OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it!

jobs.description:
Working with us means believing in the future; in the great people who are shaping it together every day and in the wide-ranging career paths it opens up. #believeinyourselfErste Group was founded in 1819 as the first Austrian savings bank and today it is one of the largest banking groups in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Department Description

The Team Corporate Underwriting & Analysis is part of the Corporate Risk Management Division of Erste Group Bank AG (Holding) and consists of a fair mix of underwriters and business analysts. It deals with corporate risk matters of Austrian and International Corporate Clients with strong focus on CEE.

The core competence consists in analyzing, recommending and/or taking credit decisions for corporate customers. In selected cases underwriters are supported by the business analysts with in-depth analysis, peer group comparisons and forecasting. 1 Corporate Risk Manager - Renewable Energy (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Assessment of the credit worthiness of large national and international corporates in Austria and CEE, including the forward looking assessment of the respective business model, repayment capability and liquidity (thereby dealing with loans, export-, trading-, project- and leveraged acquisition financings)

 * Deciding on loan applications either within your discretionary approval authority or preparing a clear recommendation to the final decision maker

 * Responsible for a dedicated portfolio of corporate client groups with focus on energy (renewable energy projects) as well as consumer goods

 * Defining of risk strategies on clients and the covered industry

 * Participating in client meetings

 * Cooperation with different departments and CEE subsidiaries within Erste Group

 * Contribution to various Group and Department projects alongside the credit process

Your Background

 * Graduate in business administration or law

 * Solid experience in Corporate Banking (Account Manager/Risk Manager/Credit Analysis/Corporate Finance) with min. 3 years of activity in these areas

 * Proven track record in risk management within the renewable energy industry

 * Familiar with lending products and legal basics

 * Strong analytical, writing and presentation skills in German and English to present complex issues concisely

 * Flexibility and resilience to perform in a fast-paced environment

 * Readiness to cooperate with colleagues of other departments/ CEE subsidiaries in a multi-cultural environment

 * Willingness to travel (occasionally)

 * Open-minded & result- and target-oriented

 * Very good language skills in German and English are a pre-condition

Our Offer

 * We take care of your personal wellbeing, career development, and we actively support your educational needs

 * Discover and enjoy the benefits of Erste Group

 * The minimum wage for this full-time position in accordance with the collective agreement with complete fulfillment of the functional profile is EUR 51.336,-- gross per year. But this is just a formality - we would be happy to talk about your actual salary in person!

 * We offer our employees the opportunity to divide their hours between working from home and at the office.

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin.
